skip.tests/contracts/server-update-local.ts: Owned by `npm run test:server-update-local`, which runs `build:server-release` first. Needs dist/release-assets/yaos-server.zip on disk and shells out to git in a temp clone.

serialReason: These suites write into the repo tree, so they must never run concurrently with each other or with a build. The runner is sequential today, which satisfies this for free; the list exists so that adding parallelism cannot silently break it.
